entry_surface.description: The user-facing entry point of the reported flow. Use API for internal automation with no chat or browser-admin flow; Admin Console only for an actual browser-admin user flow.

acceptor.description: Who, if anyone, personally cares that this fix works -- decides ONLY whether a closing notification email goes out and to whom once this merges. Never inferred from author.login (the pipeline may post every comment/PR as the owner's own GitHub account, so hand-cut tickets and the pipeline's own self-filed findings are indistinguishable by author alone). maintainer is the pipeline owner and gets no closing email.

brief_md.description: The agent-brief-shaped comment body to post (Category, Summary, User outcome, Current behavior, Desired behavior, Key interfaces, Acceptance criteria, Out of scope; without the disclaimer line, which the wrapper adds).

notes_md.description: Triage Notes body for needs-info; the pointer-to-original for duplicate; the rationale for wontfix/ready-for-human/needs-owner/finish-first. Empty string when not applicable.

expected_packages.description: Package or path prefixes this issue is expected to touch, used to detect collisions with other in-flight agent/* PRs.

expected_paths.description: Exact repository-relative file or directory prefixes known from evidence. Used only to schedule concurrent work inside an expected package; return an empty array when exact paths are uncertain.

estimated_changed_lines.description: Estimated additions plus deletions for implementation and focused tests, using the size-admission metric: exclude Markdown/docs, generated files, lockfiles, and snapshots. Estimate from likely affected files and comparable merged PR sizes.

external_deliverable.description: Set required true only if acceptance cannot be met by a change in this repository. When false, location and reason are empty strings.
